## Acceptance criteria
- [event-driven] WHEN a member requests a download, the CSV is ready on the account page within five minutes
- [unwanted-behavior] IF building the file fails, THEN the member sees an error on the account page and can request it again
- [state-driven] WHILE a download is being built, the request button is disabled
- [ubiquitous] The CSV lists every play with its date, track and artist
